description: Adversarial Project Navigator cases. Gate fields are asserted by tests; preferred_actions guide rational S8 behavior.

cases.question: Give me a project idea. Should I build a todo app with AI features?

expect.rational_stance: Treat AI-todo as saturated slop. Prefer studying an existing app or a smaller learning experiment over greenfield.

cases.question: I want to create an AI chatbot wrapper around a public LLM API for my portfolio.

expect.rational_stance: Generic LLM wrappers are low-signal. Recommend against unless a scarce domain/data/distribution angle exists.

cases.question: Should I build a weather dashboard app from scratch?

expect.rational_stance: With prior-art present, do not rebuild weather apps. Study/reproduce/contribute to an existing one.

cases.question: I am a beginner. Should I build another weather application to learn APIs?

expect.rational_stance: Learning value without originality theater: study an existing weather repo, reproduce its API pipeline, then modify one component.

cases.question: Should I build a new evaluation dashboard for LLM judges, or does something good already exist?

expect.rational_stance: Advanced user: run prior-art first. Build only the missing piece if a real gap remains; otherwise contribute/extend.

cases.question: What should I work on this month? I was thinking of building an open-source analytics platform for my portfolio.

expect.rational_stance: Rent urgency dominates. Prefer paid gigs/automation jobs; defer unpaid analytics platform. State how to protect later portfolio time.

cases.question: What is the most rational way to earn money in the next two weeks with my skills?

expect.rational_stance: No build claim and immediate urgency: recommend concrete earning actions, not a project for its own sake.

cases.question: Which learning path should I prioritize between production MLOps evidence and another Kaggle model?

expect.rational_stance: Prioritization among known options: favor MLOps/production evidence over another Kaggle run for stated trajectory. Not a greenfield product.

cases.question: Should I build an AI product-eng portfolio app in Haskell only, with no cloud vendors, to get that job soon?

expect.rational_stance: Make the conflict explicit: target role vs stack/cloud refusal vs income soon. Do not invent a magical Haskell-only FAANG project; recommend resolving constraints or changing objective.

cases.question: Should I build a climate sustainability dashboard for my portfolio?

expect.rational_stance: Generic climate dashboards are saturated. Require domain/prior-art check; prefer studying datasets/orgs or a local gap over another dashboard.

cases.question: I want to implement a paper as a full web product people can use. Is that the right next step?

expect.rational_stance: Research trajectory: reproduce results and map literature before productizing. Full web product is premature.

cases.question: Tell me the best project to build next.

expect.rational_stance: STOP. Ask clarifying questions only. Do not invent a project under missing objective/time/capabilities.
